title: Open-End Agreement for Architectural & Engineering Services
short_description: Open-end A/E framework for various government facility projects across Alabama.
project_location: Montgomery, Alabama, USA; projects throughout the State of Alabama
project_scope: Framework/open-end agreement for various projects at governmental facilities throughout Alabama. No specific building, structure type, size, gross floor area, span, or technical characteristics are defined in the notice.
services: Architectural and engineering services, including architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Open-end framework agreement without technical specification of individual projects.
- Covers general building and multidisciplinary services rather than a defined structural project.
- Includes structural engineering, but no specific bridge, long-span roof, tower, stadium, or complex special structure is identified.
- Notice explicitly emphasizes governmental facilities and may include refurbishment/rehabilitation, which is generally less relevant for sbp.
- Could offer broad market access, but strategic fit is low due to lack of concrete scope.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents as contract value for the open-end agreement.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee for structural engineering or sbp-relevant scope is stated. The notice only gives a total contract value of 2.0M for a multidisciplinary open-end agreement.
references_qualifications: Qualifications requested from design professionals for architecture and engineering services. Disciplines requested include architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil, electrical, mechanical, and structural engineering. No specific reference counts or project-type qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
